lines.text: Eagerworks AI Studio turns AI capabilities into real products, workflows and measurable outcomes.
We're a team of designers and engineers who build digital products, from the first idea to launch.
Today, more and more of what we ship runs on AI.
Here are a few of the projects we've built for our clients.
A production team describes the location they need, in their own words.
AI parses every requirement, searches the catalog, evaluates each location against the brief, and returns a personalized shortlist.
Then the conversation keeps going, and every reply makes the results sharper.
For another client, AI turns something physical into something personal.
A child places a few pieces on a board.
The system recognizes each one, reasons about how they connect, and writes a story that's entirely theirs.
We build it end to end, from the app to the story engine.
Some problems need more than an API call.
For robotics, we build the vision stack itself: hand and face detection, camera and wrist tracking, and custom datasets.
Then we train and benchmark every model, until the data is ready to teach a robot.
Computer vision turns a camera into a live source of operational data.
On a tractor, it detects, counts and measures every plant, and maps exactly where each one is.
On the packing line, every pumpkin gets its own ID the moment it appears, and keeps it until it's counted.
And when the work lives in documents, AI reads the evidence, maps it to frameworks like SOC 2 and ISO 27001, flags the gaps, and recommends what to fix.
